verdict.rationale: Fly.io's own docs state you can "Ship from GitHub," which points to a first-party GitHub deploy path. Nothing in the evidence documents an automatic trigger on every push, and the other deploy material describes manual `fly launch`/`fly deploy` CLI runs. missing for 10: documented push-triggered automatic deploys, setup/configuration docs for the GitHub integration (repo connection, branch selection), CI/CD or GitHub Actions guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration of auto-deploy on push.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Ship from GitHub or our CLI with `fly launch`.
Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
